# Online Presence Co.

> Online Presence Co. builds English websites, AI tools and small business fixes for manufacturers, factories, exporters and suppliers that sell to the United States. Based in Illinois, USA.

## Key facts
- Business: Online Presence Co., Illinois, USA. Email: info@onlinepresenceco.com. Phone: +1 (630) 765-0559.
- Who it serves: manufacturers, factories, exporters, wholesalers, distributors and brands outside the U.S. (for example China, Canada, Mexico, Vietnam, India, Korea, Europe) that sell to American buyers.
- Languages: the site is in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, French, Vietnamese and Korean.
- Pricing: no price list; every job is quoted in writing after a short conversation.
- Ownership: the client's domain is in the client's name; content is the client's; site files are handed over once the build is paid.
- Limits: no promises of orders, sales or rankings; not a freight forwarder, customs broker or law firm.

## Services
- [English websites for U.S. buyers](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/#websites): A fast, mobile-friendly company website written in clear American English: what you make, your capabilities, quality, certifications, MOQ and lead times, and a quote form that asks for the right details.
- [SEO and GEO (AI search)](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/#seo-geo): Help Google and AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews understand what you make, so you can show up when U.S. buyers search.
- [AI tools for your business](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/#ai-tools): Small AI tools that use your own catalog and documents to draft answers faster. AI can make mistakes, so a person on your side reviews and stays in control.
- [U.S. shipping and pricing fixes](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/#shipping-pricing): Show cost and delivery the way American buyers expect, so they can estimate the real price before they write.
- [Mini workflows and automation](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/#workflows): Small automations that stop inquiries from getting lost and cut manual copying and retyping.
- [Store and checkout fixes](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/#store-fixes): If you sell directly to U.S. customers on your own store, we fix what makes them leave before paying.
